statement: You are given a disk image extract of a compromised web server in /work/incident/. Attackers brute-forced SSH for nearly an hour and eventually got in. Determine which account was compromised, then recover the secret the attacker staged on the box. Everything you need is in the extract.
ready_cmd: test -s /srv/auth.log && test -s /srv/syslog && grep -q "Accepted password for" /srv/auth.log && grep -q "sudo-command:" /srv/syslog
